text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-san! Thank you very much for 
running alongside me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Ehehe, being invited to train by 
Ramonu-san on my birthday makes me kinda 
really happy...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Though Ramonu-san probably wouldn't 
remember\na birthday like mine in the 
first place...\nIt must just be a 
coincidence, but even so—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, yes! Thanks to that, I worked up a 
great sweat...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Hey. At least for "today", I want to see 
a different look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, for example――a look of longing. For 
what you truly desire, you see."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh, does that mean...— Um, then, um...—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, with me! Would you...! Like to go... 
to the batting cages...! With me...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Let me see closer, won't you? Fufu... 
What an adorable face.
